title: Managed Database: monetary decimal precision
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database monetary decimal precision is specified by contracted tier. Monetary decimal places; integer. Meter quantity decimal places; integer. Decimal tie-breaking convention for monetary and quantity rounding; string.

| Contracted tier | Monetary decimal precision | Quantity decimal precision | Rounding convention |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 2 | 6 | half-up |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 2 | 6 | half-up |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 2 | 6 | half-up |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 2 | 6 | half-up |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 2 | 6 | half-up |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 2 | 6 | half-up |

## Tier comparison
For monetary decimal precision, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 2.
